QD3-008, A20's wording, decided by me since no line is a correction: A20 keeps its words, and three wording questions go to D3c with a limit of the record. First, the mechanism says calls flood the host sub and the host answers by drawing a line, but in 51 of the 148 order rooms (0.345) every order line's first line answers no flood (NF: a sticky asked or made for visibility, a pinned call, a paused thread, a worth question or dismissal). The falsifier's second clause, recorded present, and the bound hold these lines, so no line shows the order failing for want of a condition A20 lacks; the question is whether the mechanism should name the line as an answer to the calls, with the flood as one form of it. Second, the connection counts a dismissal of the canvas, and G26 counts worth arguments; the census reads members' worth remarks, including those of members who join in the same post (uofm-051, kurdistan-050) and judgments after the close (transformers-055, the_pack-045, chess-050), as the host's line. Whether a participant's remark is the host's line goes to D3c. Third, the bound shows alone in 16 of 164 episode rooms (0.098), beside the counterexample response's 23 of 155; the bound's words name canvas subs and megathreads first and early dismissals, and the 16 rooms show these forms. The limit of the record: a reply that points a call to a sticky or megathread already made reports a line at an hour the record does not show (reading 23), so 17 lines are one act, and nintendo's audited support transition is one of them (nintendo-063 re-ruled, nintendo-064 an evidence limit).

G53's readings 1 to 7, stated while reading P06's instantiate window i199_000 (25 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. Instantiate classes: SHOW (accept, specification), NOT (reject: the concepts show another element instead), VIS (reject: only a visitor's attribution, with no answer from the room), P-G6 (particular), with tags for the census. (1) Naming the room or group that changes the work is P06's tracing, with or without evidence, since the range starts at one question (49ers c0034; AceOfAngels8 c0026; Dustforce c0007; DestinyTheGame c0287, which also names a motive: TR). (2) A member's own wrong placement, a member's script that kills the work by accident, and a mistaken accusation withdrawn are the room's own mistake (2007scape c1043; AcePlace c0089; GabrielDropout c0046; Dominican c0044; AmericanFlaginPlace c0215; Fez c0073, a blame post withdrawn after a neighbour's denial: OM). (3) Members of the room changing the work by a rival design, or working against each other, are friendly fire (AMD c0157, c0381; AyyMD c0054, c0074, c0084; EraseThePlace c0268: FF). (4) Tracing by posting histories, timing, patterns or lack of history is P06's tracing (AvoArmy c0131; FederationPlace c0019; Dominican c0020; FlaggyFlag c0011; FloydVsVoid c0120; CKCrusaders c0066, rogues told from the official neighbour). (5) A visitor's disowning or denial in the room's thread is the visitor's room's form; the line shows P06 here through the room's own member, who traces, admits or answers (ChronoTrigger c0007 beside c0006; AmericanFlaginPlace c0482 beside c0430; Fez c0072 beside c0073; CelticFc c0005, answered by c0006 naming the Bruins). (6) TURN marks an attribution answered in the same post or its chain by a coordinating act under the A1 rule: a call to defend, watch, attack or rebuild, a repair, or a script set to help (2007scape c1166; AceOfAngels8 c0026; AyyMD c0073; ChronoTrigger c0006; DatBoi c0025, c0044; DevonUK c0007; Dominican c0038, c0065; FlaggyFlag c0012; DCFU c0006). A call to stop a witch hunt directs talk, not the work, so it is not a TURN (AMD c0226). (7) A NONPORTABLE line whose concepts show P06 is a particular marked PO (4chan-026, an apology for a mistaken removal; DCFU-007). Window i199_000 classed: SHOW 23, P-G6 2 (both PO).
